Renders w-full h-full so it needs an explicitly sized parent, and a mouse play area (auto-demo animates when idle). Skipped fluid-sim knobs: isViscous, viscous, iterationsViscous, iterationsPoisson, dt, BFECC, isBounce, takeoverDuration, autoResumeDelay, autoRampDuration, style, className. | visual-fix: frontImage and backImage are required props with no defaults, so ours shows only the fluid sim's pink/purple dye blob over the cursor hint i

plasma-tide.notes: Defaults to width/height 100%, so it needs an explicitly sized parent; backgroundColor only shows when transparent is off. Skipped: width, height, opacity, children, className. WebGL scene rebuilds on any prop change.

umbra-columns.notes: Uses next-themes useTheme() — without a ThemeProvider it falls back to the dark rendering path (undefined resolvedTheme). Fills a 100% x 100% div, so it needs a sized parent. Color props are [r,g,b] 0-1 tuples (baseColor, baseColorLight, proximityColor, proximityColorLight) and can't be mapped to a color control — skipped, along with noisePower, fuzzIntensity, className.

satin-ripples.notes: Renders w-full h-full — needs a sized parent (transparent background, dark backdrop shows the default blue silk palette best). The colors prop (array of exactly 8 hex strings) can't be a simple control and is skipped, along with contrast, offsetX, offsetY, opacity, className, style. Prop changes update uniforms live without a scene rebuild.

pulse-chart.notes: data (DataPoint[]) is REQUIRED — supplied inline. Hover the dots for spring-animated tooltips. Skipped to stay under 8 controls: width, height, animationDuration, gridLines ('vertical'|'horizontal'|'both'), gridLineThickness, dotSize, dotHoverGlow, calculatePercentageDifference, animateOnScroll, animateOnce, className.

soft-eddy.notes: Defaults to width/height 100% — needs a sized parent. Shader loop hard-caps layers at 30. cursorInteraction warps twist/line weight near the pointer (pairs with cursorIntensity, skipped). Also skipped: direction (1/-1), layerStep, gamma, vignetteStart, vignetteEnd, glowStrength, glowRadius, opacity, cursorIntensity, children, className. | visual-fix: The swirl shape matches but the component's backgroundColor prop defaults to #ffffff, producing a pastel swirl on a white scene, while the o

slant-reel.notes: No required props; default items are 10 remote Unsplash slides (initialIndex 3). Supports drag, arrow keys when focused, and click-to-focus. Skipped: items, initialIndex, aspectRatio (CSS ratio string), borderRadius, titleBlur, autoplayDelay, showControls, showDots, enableDrag, enableKeyboard, onIndexChange, className.

glide-pointer.notes: Renders a fixed inset-0 full-viewport canvas overlay (pointer-events-none, z-9999) listening to window mousemove — the whole page is the play area, not just its parent. demoProps override color to #5227FF because the upstream default #000000 is invisible on dark backgrounds (Reset restores black). Skipped: smoothFactor, mixBlendMode (GlobalCompositeOperation union, several values blank the canvas), className.
